definitions.explanation: A pen with a flexible, brush-like tip and a built-in ink supply, used to write in a calligraphic brush style without grinding ink.

examples.japanese: {筆|ふで}ペン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote New Year's cards with a brush pen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{香典袋|こうでんぶくろ}→香典袋：24487_koudenbukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆|ふで}ペン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: You write your name on a condolence envelope with a brush pen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毛筆|もうひつ}→毛筆：14907_mouhitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{筆|ふで}ペンなら⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I'm bad with a real brush, but with a brush pen I can easily write beautiful characters.

notes:
A ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧ (brush) + ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧ (pen): a flexible brush-like tip with a built-in ink supply. Convenient for formal writing — addressing ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧ (New Year's cards) and ceremonial envelopes — without preparing real ink.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆|ふで}ペン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write with a brush pen
- {筆|ふで}ペン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: brush-pen lettering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毛筆|もうひつ}→毛筆：14907_mouhitsu⟧: a traditional ink brush — needs dipping or grinding ink; {筆|ふで}ペン mimics it conveniently
- ⟦サインペン→サインペン：24225_sainpen⟧: felt-tip marker pen — for everyday writing, not a calligraphic style
